    Welcome, keeper

    Learn its language.

    This garden responds to signals, not ordinary gardening. Each plant follows a hidden, consistent rule. Your task is to discover it.

    1. Select a plant.
    2. Send Light, Sound or Water.
    3. Watch the reaction. Try a new hypothesis.

    Signals build on the plant’s current state. An incorrect signal clears its preparation. Bloomed plants stay open. Reset to repeat the same experiment. New challenge creates a different signal language, then keeps it fixed for the whole round.

    New discoveries: later chapters introduce three-signal patterns, one-time root relays, a night-only flower, echo-only final signals and flowers that wait for a neighbour. Every new rule is explained in the chapter brief.

    Explore without a move limit, or switch to Challenge for an exact move budget. Changing modes starts a fresh attempt. Undo and reset are always available. Hints reveal progressively; your notebook survives resets.
